[RARC.4.5] **In scope.** This policy governs every artefact DS defines that
persists across a process or a release boundary. That includes a compiled
`.dsc` and a fact-stream recording, each of which records the DS version that
wrote it ([LDET.1.10]). Each format's spec **must** cite this section where it
states its refusal, and the refusal has no opt-out.
